Indian National Charged with Drug Trafficking and Weapons Offenses in US

An Indian national, identified as Kawal Preet Singh, 50, has been charged in the United States with drug trafficking and possessing illegal arms. Authorities allege Singh was distributing methamphetamine from a Round Table Pizza restaurant in California. Law enforcement seized over 40 pounds of methamphetamine and firearms from the location. If convicted of drug trafficking, Singh faces a mandatory minimum sentence of 10 years and a maximum of life in prison, along with a potential fine of up to $10 million.
